reason: Release 50: #2039 (claude/butterfly-id): Butterfly gets its own id; the moth on the bench (Ed, 2026-11-13: "Note that the moth was replaced by a butterfly."; "can we actually rename it in the files and put the moth on the bench?"): the swallowtail that wore the moth's id since 2026-10-23 is the kind `butterfly`, with the moth's island, numbers, attacks and look, and the moth is a kind on the bench, with no island. Nothing of the game changes: whatever is drawn or sounded from a kind's name is still drawn from the old one (art/creatures/renamed.js seedId), so its island's shape, the night's set, its voice, melody, coat, motes and circle are as they were, and a save or link naming the moth loads the butterfly. Nine islands' maps, its voices and a 120 s bot night on its island came out identical to the last digit, and its sheet pixel for pixel the same; so the only difference the bench should see is the name itself, wherever a fingerprint carries a creature's species.; #1999 (claude/legend-back): Sleeping legends lie at the back of their circles (Ed, 2026-11-12: "Legends should sleep at the back of their circles, so you can stand in the circle before them"): legendClearing.back 0.7 of the radius north of the middle (0.45 before), each circle sized so the legend's sleeping width still fits there with its margin, so legend circles are up to about a quarter bigger (never past fit.max or fit.areaMax). Challenge circles unchanged. Since 2026-11-13 (Ed: "fix the others"): circles are sized from the legends as drawn now (config/legend-footprints.json measured again, a mesh kind's from its mesh), so every legend circle's size changes, some smaller, and a legend lies further back where its nap would otherwise be drawn over her at the circle's middle.; #2044 (claude/wild-babies): Wild babies keep out of fights, as her leashed ones do (Ed, 2026-11-13: "wild babies should avoid combat in the way that friendly babies do"; src/rules/wildBabies.ts): a wild baby with a fight within combat.defendRadius runs to a spot of its own area leash.babies.scatter off it and roams again leash.babies.calm seconds after; its roam and its notice of her leave it be meanwhile. Creatures carry a new optional field, shy. No new knobs.; #2040 (claude/long-lunge): Long lunges (Ed, 2026-11-13: "Lunge ranges seem very short; they could be twice as long, around 1.5-2 dashes range"; how: "Both"): a lunging creature's wind-up may begin about 1.5 dashes off its target, it gathers itself there instead of sprinting in, and its lunge runs 1.5 to 2 dashes (22.5 to 30 m) along its line, through and past its target, its blow landing as it passes. At her, at her party and her party's at wild ones; ?lunge=old the lunges as before.

rules.*: wherever a fingerprint carries a creature's or an island's species: "butterfly" where it read "moth", the same creature in the same place doing the same thing (no number changes); legend circles' sizes and so their places, the sleeping legends' spots (and lair) in them, their wild babies' spots, and what the map places round them (grove, rim kit, trees, decor, other sites kept their gaps from the bigger circles); what follows in creatures' states and positions near them; wherever a fight comes within 30 m of a wild baby: its place (run off from the fight), its roam's seeded draws after, and what follows from them; and the new shy field wherever a creature's fields are listed; wherever a creature lunges: where it winds up from, where its lunge ends, when and whether its blow lands, and what follows (who's hit, the fight's course, her health)

frames.*: where a legend circle or the forest round one is in view: the circle bigger, its legend further back (north) in it, the trees, rim and grove round it moved with it; wherever a fight is in view near wild babies: the babies gone from beside it, further off in their area; wherever a creature lunges in view: its red lunge warning is 22.5 to 30 m long and begins further off, and the creature ends its lunge well past its target
